text:
The most recent Republican to be elected Governor of New York was **George Pataki** in 1994.  
On the November 8, 1994 ballot his name appeared under the following party lines:

| Party line on the ballot | Party name |
|---------------------------|-------------|
| Republican | New York Republican Party |
| Conservative | Conservative Party of New York |
| Tax Cut Now | Tax Cut Now Party |
| Liberal | Liberal Party of New York |

These party designations are listed in the official election record for George Pataki’s first gubernatorial victory【3†L469-L476】.
